title: Corrupted Miao Audio Overhaul 1.0.0
author: punkdude
description:
This mod is intended for usage in conjunction with the Lazy's Corrupted Miao Ying Progression and Kerberos's Azazel's Realm (play as Azazel or Miao). There are 2 mods:

-
Corrupted Miao Audio Overhaul replaces some of Miao's immersion-breaking lines with AI-generated ones that are Slaanesh-worshipping/slutty (not all lines are replaced; wanted to keep as much of the VA's great work as possible). Mostly changes lines that call herself the Storm Dragon to Whore Dragon, references to the Emperor, and being anti-Chaos

-
Corrupted Miao Moans replaces her grunts/shouts/yells in battle with moans or BJ sounds (note that these may be difficult to hear, TW:WH3 battles are LOUD)

-
The 3rd file is just some example audio from the AI Audio Overhaul, if you want to listen to what they sound like

To install, just place at the bottom of the load order, but this should only be done AFTER Miao hits Stage 4 in LazyIcarus's primary Corrupted Miao Mod - it is intended for usage in conjunction with that.

There are no major conflicts, however Kerberos's Azazel's Realm mod uses some of Miao's vanilla lines for the cutscenes in that mod. As a result, Miao will say things that don't line up with the text of those events when this mod is active (and which are way hornier than what is written). A slight inconsistency but not game-breaking and doesn't change the base text of the event.
